In [[3963 BBY]], during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] '''captured''' the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Jebble]] after securing the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] then moved on to the planet [[Serroco]], and used Jebble as a staging ground for a planned assault on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
